backend: SigNoz 0.152.0, native collector 0.144.19, ClickHouse/Keeper 26.11.4.11, PostgreSQL 16.16 metadata
consistency: eventual query visibility; fenced acknowledged source records must reconcile
atomicity: no cross-signal or whole-source-batch atomicity claim
idempotency: not claimed; source has no automatic retries; duplicate returned source copies fail qualification
durability: native batch processors precede exporters and exporter queues are disabled; source ACK is not assumed to prove backend persistence; process-crash ACK survival is an explicit empirical gate
retention: native logs initially 15 days; native stale-data filter 360h; current corpus lies inside tested retention windows; equal-TTL and retention/reclamation comparison not qualified
selected_logs: exact body, nanosecond timestamp/observed time, trace/span IDs and flags, source logical attributes, severity, resource and scope
selected_metrics: millisecond time/value/flags, verified fingerprint-to-series metadata, name/unit/type/labels/resource/scope
selected_traces: IDs, parent, state, flags, name/kind/status/message, nanosecond start/duration, logical attributes, scope, events and native references
projection_limits: OTLP links become CHILD_OF/FOLLOWS_FROM references without OTLP link attributes/state/flags
millisecond metric schema does not qualify submillisecond precision
known_findings_before_full: PostgreSQL agent cleanup reports DISTINCT/ORDER BY error
native attributes_number filter with integer literal fails BAD_GET on current ClickHouse; explicit float or native JSON path works
limits: single-host compatibility evaluation; no HA, Kubernetes, disk/power loss, independent restore or production security qualification
